notes.title: Polar Pathways is out now!
notes.content: [h1]🥳 Our lil penguin game is out now! 🥳 [/h1][h3]🐧Thank you all for your support on our discord, on our socials and even in our in person events! 🐧 [/h3][p][/p][h3]☃️ We hope you have fun waddling and sliding around in our world! ☃️ [/h3][p][/p][h3]❄️The perfect game to play with a young one as there's no pressures or constraints, works on a controller and is short and cute! ❄️ [/h3][h3][/h3][h3]✨Please let us know your thoughts and share the game with our friends, it helps our indie team a lot ✨[/h3][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/GqH_flbthcc?si=w-9ysVT1FrzW_eel"][/dynamiclink][/p]
